title: Gate value is preserved under child-wise equality
statement: Fix a Boolean flag $\mathit{isAnd}$ and a finite list $c_1,\dots,c_k$ of Boolean circuits on $m$ variables, and let $d_1,\dots,d_k$ be Boolean circuits on $M$ variables, one for each position of the list. Given assignments $g : \mathrm{Fin}\,m \to \bbf_2$ and $g' : \mathrm{Fin}\,M \to \bbf_2$ such that every re-indexed child agrees with the corresponding original child, i.e. $d_j$ evaluated at $g'$ equals $c_j$ evaluated at $g$ for each position $j$, the gate node with flag $\mathit{isAnd}$ over $c_1,\dots,c_k$ evaluated at $g$ equals the gate node with the same flag $\mathit{isAnd}$ over $d_1,\dots,d_k$ evaluated at $g'$. Here the node is the conjunction of its children's values when $\mathit{isAnd} = \mathrm{true}$ and their disjunction when $\mathit{isAnd} = \mathrm{false}$.
hypotheses_covered: gate flag isAnd (shared by both nodes)
original children c_1,...,c_k on m variables
re-indexed children d_1,...,d_k on M variables, one per position
assignment g on m variables and g' on M variables
child-wise equality: d_j at g' equals c_j at g for each position j
replaced:
If each re-indexed child $\mathrm{new\_cs}\,j$ evaluated at $g'$ agrees with the original
child $cs.\mathrm{get}\,j$ evaluated at $g$, then the node over $cs$ at $g$ equals the node
over $(\mathrm{List.finRange}\,cs.\mathrm{length}).\mathrm{map}\,\mathrm{new\_cs}$ at $g'$,
for the same flag $\mathit{isAnd}$.
